svg.title: Venting changes the pressure difference across the floor
svg.desc: Calculated curves from an explicitly assumed linear two-compartment model, not accident measurements. Higher intercompartment conductance lowers the maximum floor differential.
svg.text: Venting changes the pressure difference across the floor
Assumed: initial overpressure 20 kPa; cargo outflow coefficient 8 /s; vent coefficients 0.6 and 6 /s.
Equal pressure capacitances; linear surrogate. Not compressible-flow sizing or reconstructed Flight 981 data.
